embed.title: !poracle
embed.description: Register with the bot, or switch your account back on.

fields.name: Register
fields.value:
Run `{{prefix}}poracle` in your server's registration channel — ask an admin which one. On Telegram, run it in the registration group; it doesn't work in a private chat with the bot.

The bot then sends you a welcome message by direct message. Some servers register you automatically when you get the right role.

If your server has set up a registration word for your language, using that word instead also sets your language.

fields.name: Already registered
fields.value:
If you paused alerts with `{{prefix}}stop`, running `{{prefix}}poracle` again turns them back on, like `{{prefix}}start`.

If you were disabled (for example, you lost a server role or kept going over the alert limit), it brings you back only if your server allows that. If it doesn't, ask an admin.

fields.name: Next steps
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}location <address or lat,lon>` — set your location
`{{prefix}}area list` — see the areas you can choose
`{{prefix}}track pikachu iv:90-100 d:500` — your first tracking rule
`{{prefix}}help` — all commands
